name: New Life
summary: Tammra Windfield sends travelers west from Sun Rock Retreat to plant Gaea seeds in the Charred Vale. She hopes the scorched land can begin to heal.

sections.title: Healing the Scorched Earth
sections.body: Tammra Windfield sends you into the Charred Vale, where soot, fire elementals, and harpies haunt the ruined ground. She trusts in the Earth Mother's resilience and asks you to find Gaea Dirt Mounds, where fertile soil survived the fire.

sections.title: A Foothold for the Future
sections.body: Gaea seeds can take root despite the lingering elemental corruption. Their roots form an ecological anchor against decay and invite plants back into the valley. Tammra hopes that, as life reclaims the basin, the fire spirits will settle, the harpies will lose their desolate roost, and the Venture Company's logging will eventually be driven out.

faq.q: What is the purpose of planting the Gaea seeds?
faq.answer: The enchanted Gaea seeds can take root in the Charred Vale's scarred earth and resist corruption. They give plant life a foothold from which the forest can gradually regrow and heal.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to plant the seeds?
aliases: where do i plant gaea seeds
faq.answer: Travel west from Sun Rock Retreat into the Charred Vale, where Gaea Dirt Mounds are scattered across the blackened basin.

Tammra Windfield is a tauren naturalist who lives in Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. She works to soothe the land's wounded spirits and restore places ravaged by elemental fury and industrial greed.

faq.q: What threats roam the Charred Vale while planting?
faq.answer: Rogue fire elementals stirred by the devastation and aggressive Bloodfury harpies roam the Charred Vale. The harpies nest among the burnt trees.

faq.q: What quest comes before New Life?
faq.answer: Cycle of Rebirth comes before New Life. You helped Tammra gather the materials needed to prepare the enchanted Gaea seeds.

faq.q: What does Tammra hope will happen to Stonetalon long term?
faq.answer: Tammra hopes regrowth will calm the enraged fire elementals, drive away the predatory harpies, and outlast the Venture Company's logging operations. She wants the mountains restored to a lush, peaceful forest.

angles.text: For tauren, planting enchanted seeds in scarred soil joins them in communion with the Earth Mother and fulfills their sacred duty to heal wounded lands.
As a druid, you share Tammra's work to renew the Charred Vale and restore nature's delicate balance.
As a shaman, you know the agitated fire elementals will never find peace until the battered land begins to heal.
As an herbalist, you appreciate the seeds' power to bring thriving vegetation from deadened soil.
